parse.title: Mining
parse.wikitext:
'''Mining''' is a gathering activity in Vampire Life. With a Pickaxe, you can break ore rocks to collect ore, then smelt ore into bars at the Blacksmith's Forge or sell ore to the Ore Buyer for in-game money.

== Getting Started ==
* Buy a '''Pickaxe''' from the Weapons Shop merchant in the second village ($500) before you can mine.

== Ores ==
Each ore rock shows its ore name and a health bar. Breaking a rock yields exactly 1 ore of that rock's type.
* '''Silver''' — silver-grey rock, 120 health. Yields 1 Silver.
[[File:Mining-silver-rock.png|thumb|Silver ore rock (120 health).]]
* '''Ruby''' — red rock, 125 health. Yields 1 Ruby.
[[File:Mining-ruby-rock.png|thumb|Ruby ore rock (125 health).]]
* '''Coal''' — black rock, 50 health. Yields 1 Coal. Coal is used as fuel for smelting.
[[File:Mining-coal-rock.png|thumb|Coal ore rock (50 health).]]

== Mining XP ==
Mining grants XP: 3 XP for coal, 6 XP for silver, and 9 XP for rubies, before multipliers.

== Smelting ==
Smelt ore at the '''Blacksmith's Forge''', located near the weapons merchant NPC in the second village (press E at the forge).
[[File:Blacksmith-forge-smelt.png|thumb|The Blacksmith's Forge near the weapons merchant in the second village.]]
Coal is fuel. Select Silver or Ruby, then press SMELT:
* '''Silver Bar''' — 1 Silver + 4 Coal → 1 bar.
[[File:Blacksmith-forge-silver-bar.png|thumb|Smelting a Silver Bar (1 Silver + 4 Coal).]]
Silver Bars are also used in Weapons Shop recipes (Silver Stake and Rapier) — see [[Items#Weapons Shop]].
* '''Ruby Bar''' — 1 Ruby + 10 Coal → 1 bar.
[[File:Blacksmith-forge-ruby-bar.png|thumb|Smelting a Ruby Bar (1 Ruby + 10 Coal).]]

== Selling Ore ==
Ore can be sold to the '''Ore Buyer''' for in-game money. Ore Buyers are found in both the first village and the second village. Ore is sold in batches of 60:
* 60 Coal → $4000
* 60 Silver → $6000
* 60 Ruby → $9000
[[File:Ore-buyer.png|thumb|The Ore Buyer offers $4000 for 60 Coal, $6000 for 60 Silver, and $9000 for 60 Ruby.]]
